comment: Naruto Wind Style Rasenshuriken: four wide swept white-blue wind blades (shaded pale blue edges) around a blue Rasengan core with a white 3-arm swirl, a faint pale-blue ringing disc (radius 61) and swirling wind arcs between the blades; the blades turn 90 deg per 8-frame loop (seamless). Origin = the Rasengan core at the centre; blade tips reach 66 px, the disc 61 px, so hit radius 60. Symmetric, so it reads the same mirrored.

Tailed Beast Bomb (Kurama): a 88 px dense sphere, near-black at the centre shading to dark purple with a faint purple 4-arm swirl, a thin lavender-white rim, a ragged dark-blue chakra aura and pale blue/white swirl arcs turning around it (to ~60 px), white glints. Origin = sphere centre; the solid sphere is radius 44, aura to ~60, hit radius 50. Loop of 8 frames, seamless.

Sasuke Kirin: a blue-white lightning dragon head (dark-navy outlined, cel-shaded blue, spiky mane and horns, glowing almond eye, jaws wide open with white fangs and lightning glowing in the throat) diving down head-first, angled snout-down, fed by a writhing lightning column from the top of the frame (the column runs off the top edge on purpose: it comes from the sky); white crackle bolts flicker over the head and around it every frame, an impact flash and sparks at the jaws. ORIGIN = the impact point under the open jaws (bottom centre). Hit circle radius 42 at the origin covers the jaws; the head itself spans about x -45..+45, y -130..0 from the origin if the game wants a taller capsule. 8-frame loop at 15 fps: play it while the strike lasts.

Sasuke Indra's Arrow: a 210 px arrow of purple lightning chakra flying right: violet shaft with a white-hot core fading toward the tail, a sharp shaded barbed arrowhead (tip at x 228), a double helix of white-lavender lightning wrapping the shaft and jagged bolts re-rolling every frame along it, crackles off the arrowhead and spark streaks spraying back off the tail. ORIGIN = the middle of the arrowhead (206,42); hit radius 22 covers the head; the shaft runs back to x 22 (184 px behind the origin, half-height ~10) if the game wants a long capsule.

Starrk's blue cero (Bleach, one Cero Metralleta shot): a 36 px ball of blue energy banded in to a white-hot core, inside a ~48 px dark-blue reiatsu aura with a navy edge whose swept-back flame licks stream into a short tapered comet tail (tip ~44 px behind the centre, light flow lines inside), white speed streaks above and below, a few glints. No spiral (that would read as a Rasengan). Flies right. Origin = the ball centre (62,30); hit radius 21 covers the ball and its aura (the tail is only visual). 8-frame seamless loop; small enough to fire in volleys.

Starrk's Los Lobos wolf (Bleach) of blue cero energy galloping right: a ~100 px wolf (nose to tail tip) glowing pale blue-white at its core and shading to blue at the edges, wrapped in a dark-blue reiatsu aura with a navy edge whose flame licks stream back along the neck, back and bushy tail; pointed ear, open jaws, dark slit eye. 8-frame double-suspension gallop (extended leap, front legs land, gathered tuck, hind legs push), near legs bright, far legs darker blue; white-blue sparks, embers and speed streaks trail behind. Origin = the chest (89,34): hit radius 24 covers the jaws and front half. The nose is 30 px ahead of the origin and the tail tip 72 px behind it, so for the whole wolf use a capsule x 17..119 at y 36 with half-height 14.

Kakashi's Susanoo Kamui Shuriken (Naruto): a ~130 px four-bladed shuriken of cyan Susanoo chakra. Curved blades sweep back against the spin, with a pale cyan body, a deep-blue rim, a navy edge and a white ridge down each blade. In the centre is a dark Kamui vortex: a near-black hole with a slate-blue 3-arm swirl turning the other way, ringed in cyan. It spins fast and clockwise, 22.5 deg per frame (180 deg per 8-frame loop, so frames 4-7 repeat 0-3; seamless), and tapered blue motion smears trail each blade tip. Flies right (the spin reads the same mirrored). Origin = the Kamui centre (72,72); the blade tips reach 62-65 px, so hit radius 55 covers the blades (their tips are thin).
